description: Defines options and configuration structures for various convolution and transposed convolution modules in PyTorch's C++ API, including parameters like channels, kernel size, stride, padding, dilation, groups, bias, and padding mode.

classes.name: ConvNdOptions
classes.description: Template class for options of N-dimensional convolution or transpose convolution modules.

classes.name: ConvOptions
classes.description: Template class for options of N-dimensional convolution modules.

classes.name: ConvTransposeOptions
classes.description: Template class for options of N-dimensional transpose convolution modules.

classes.name: ConvFuncOptions
classes.description: Template class for options of convolution functional calls.

classes.name: ConvTransposeFuncOptions
classes.description: Template class for options of transpose convolution functional calls.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Sets padding using an initializer list of integers.
